rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for conduct or things regarded as disgraceful or socially embarrassing.

example.english: Yelling at people that loudly at someone else’s wedding is really shameful.
example.traditional: 你喺人哋婚禮上面咁大聲鬧人，真係好失禮。
example.jyutping: nei5 hai2 jan4 dei6 fan1 lai5 soeng6 min6 gam2 daai6 seng1 naau6 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 lai5

rows.note: Use this when the shameful thing specifically makes someone lose face or look bad.

example.english: Being yelled at until he cried in front of the whole company was really shameful.
example.traditional: 佢喺成間公司嘅人面前畀人鬧到喊，真係好丟架。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 seng4 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jan4 min6 cin4 bei2 jan4 naau6 dou3 haam3 zan1 hai6 hou2 diu1 gaa2

rows.note: Use this for explicit moral condemnation, especially in formal or written language.

example.english: Misusing public funds is truly shameful.
example.traditional: 濫用公帑嘅行為實在可恥。
example.jyutping: laam6 jung6 gung1 tong2 ge3 hang4 wai4 sat6 zoi6 ho2 ci2
